subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Revises (or teaches) the consonant digraph sh

show.line: Shh! Two letters make one sound. Ship, shop, shell. They all start with shh. Fish ends with shh!

rounds.prompt: Which picture starts like ship? Shh.
Put your finger on your lips. Say the quiet sound. Shh!
Which picture ends like fish? Shh at the end.
What is this? It starts with shh.
Which two letters make the shh sound?
rounds.praise: Yes! Those two letters say shh.

rounds.prompt: Does it have the shh sound? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Listen for the quiet sound. Shh, like telling someone to be quiet.
Say the word slowly. Do you hear shh at the start or the end?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with shh.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sun starts with sss. Ship starts with shh.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Shh, ship. Ship starts with shh!

parent_line: Can hear and read the sh sound at the start and end of words.
